seed_fields.description: Split text into word runs, whitespace runs and individual other code points. Alphabets are explicit disjoint strings; repeated alphabet characters do not affect membership. Empty alphabets and empty input are supported. Joining output tokens exactly recovers input. Punctuation is never merged unless included in a run alphabet. No case folding, Unicode normalization, stemming, transliteration or whitespace deletion occurs. Combining marks and emoji are code points, not grapheme clusters. Runs are local to a whole input string; independent chunk tokenization need not preserve boundaries. Caller selects domain policy and maintains it across training/inference. Executes serially with no fitted state or worker processes.

interfaces.name: text
interfaces.constraints: Unicode Python string; empty input allowed. No coercion of missing values, case folding, normalization, transliteration, stemming or deletion. Caller resolves table missing-value policies before this operation.

interfaces.name: word_characters
interfaces.constraints: Explicit string whose code points form the word-run alphabet. Empty and repeated characters allowed; membership only matters. Must be disjoint from whitespace_characters. Caller preserves the same policy across training and inference and chooses it for the intended domain.

interfaces.name: whitespace_characters
interfaces.constraints: Explicit string whose code points form the whitespace-run alphabet. Empty and repeated characters allowed. No automatic Unicode whitespace expansion. Must be disjoint from word_characters; characters outside both alphabets become individual tokens.

interfaces.name: result
interfaces.constraints: Ordered list of nonempty string tokens; empty input returns an empty list. Consecutive word or whitespace code points form runs; all other code points are individual tokens. Joining tokens exactly reproduces the input. Code-point semantics are not grapheme or linguistic segmentation. Independent chunk tokenization may change run boundaries. Witness metadata gives bounds only, not an exact token-array shape.

limitations: Draft identities only; canonical draft and legacy flagged, both unpublished, until separate publication qualification.
Witness describes token-count bounds and lossless code-point preservation only. Caller chooses domain-appropriate alphabets and preserves policy between training and inference.
Requires the installed sciona tokenizer core and registry. Runs serially without worker processes. Dependency qualification remains pending.
Complete metadata, dependency qualification, transaction rollback tests and served-selection verification remain required.
No original competition CDG approval or historical winning-ensemble completeness is implied.
